name: Avic Aviation High-Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Avic Aviation High-Technology Co., Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells aviation new materials and intelligent equipment in China. It operates through Equipment Business and Aviation New Materials segments. The company offers CNC machining centers, CNC gantry milling machines, CNC gantry machining centers, and aviation special equipment. The company was formerly known as Tontec Technology Investment Group Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Avic Aviation High-Technology Co., Ltd. in May 2016. Avic Aviation High-Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Nantong, China.
